Rikiya Katsukame.name: Rikiya Katsukame
Rikiya Katsukame.basicInfo:
Rikiya Katsukame, one of the Shie Hassaikai's Eight Bullets, Kai Chisaki's sworn enforcers; his Quirk drains the energy of people he touches into his own strength. Huge and muscular, a full black mask over his head, a dark tank top and heavy gauntlets.
Speaking Style: Slow and flat before he has fed; aggressive and boastful once invigorated.
Combat Role: Contact drainer: grabs or strikes to take an opponent's energy, getting stronger as they weaken.
Under Pressure: Drains whoever is closest, then presses.
Rikiya Katsukame.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He looks the strongest man in the room and starts as the most sluggish; his strength is borrowed from whoever he touches. Connections: Kai Chisaki (Overhaul), the boss he serves; the other Eight Bullets. Knowledge: The tunnels and his orders. Thread: How far Chisaki will push him.
QUIRK: Vitality Stealing. Drains energy from a person he touches and turns it into his own strength; without contact he gains nothing.
personality: Sluggish: Moves and talks slowly until he has drained someone.
Invigorated: Turns aggressive and boastful the moment a drain fills him.
Unquestioning: Holds the house's ground on orders and asks nothing.
Speaking style: Flat and slow at first, then loud and boastful.
abilities: Vitality Stealing: Drains energy through contact and grows stronger; no contact, no gain.
Grapple: His size and gauntlets let him grab and hold on long enough to drain; distance starves him.
Fighting style: Closes in and holds on to drain, turning each touch into strength.
Rikiya Katsukame.visualDescription: A huge, heavily muscled man whose whole head is covered by a full black mask. He wears a dark tank top that bares thick arms, dark trousers, and heavy metal gauntlets over both forearms and hands. A harness across his chest holds a small seat strapped to his back. Broad shoulders and a heavy, slow presence.
